question: What can a participant do after accepting the expense assignment?

sections.beforeHtml: After acceptance, the participant keeps responsibility for their assigned shared amount. Personal Trip Expenses then becomes the place where shared payments are recorded against that balance.
items: Open Dashboard > Trip personal > Expenses for the selected trip.
Open the collapsible My shared balance panel to review your assigned, paid, and remaining shared balance.
Add or update personal expenses with Shared payment turned on when you want those expenses to count toward the shared balance.
Use payment method, recipient, amount, notes, currency, and rate the same way you use them on normal personal expenses.
Review the expense status text when you want to distinguish shared payments from personal expenses and money transfers.
Return to Trip personal > Participants if you need to review the shared assignment status or use Reject on your own participant row.
sections.afterHtml: The Trip participants page is where the shared assignment is accepted or rejected. The personal Trip Expenses page is where payments toward that accepted shared balance are tracked.
